methodology: Executes the complete current app.js in an isolated Node VM using real garden/level/engine modules, fake localStorage, and DOM/canvas adapters. Completion fixtures exercise actual engine completion events and app handlers. No real browser or user saves are read or changed.
limitations: DOM and canvas adapters verify integration state, not visual appearance, accessibility behavior, or browser-specific storage.
Completion fixtures do not measure gameplay difficulty; dedicated physics and Rush tests cover mechanics.

results.name: Startup migrates an old save once and preserves all existing progress and preferences
Malformed individual daily entries cannot reset valid campaign, Rush, or planted meadow records
Actual selection and planting handlers persist exactly one stage, including a zero-balance reload
Completed Rush rewards are saved before the result dialog and cannot repeat on dialog reopen
Restarting an unfinished run does not grant rewards
Visual previews grant no progress and restore the original in-progress run ID for its reward
Visual preview restoration retains an already-earned result amount without regranting
Campaign integration supplies pre-mutation stars so only new stars earn seeds
Reduced-motion planting draws the final saved growth and stops unnecessary meadow redraws
QA and normal storage namespaces remain isolated
Unavailable device storage reports the limitation while keeping this visit playable
Moon trials use separate records, reward new stars, unlock the next trial, and keep Meadow progress
Locked Moon buttons and malformed individual Moon records cannot grant or erase progress
A world preview restores a Moon trial and its reward without leaking it to Meadow or daily records
Koi pools 1 and 2 are free, keep their own records, and pools 3 to 8 never start without the pack
The Koi unlock names its contents and store price and buys only through the store
Clearing a Rush wave shows the next tempo, and the HUD and result carry the tempo reached
The Launch Bundle states its price and saving, buys both parts at once, and then disappears
Owning either part offers only the other part, never the bundle
Without comparable amounts the bundle still says it costs less, but names no number; off sale or on the website it is not offered
Keepsakes: a fresh garden wears Meadow, every style previews, and locked styles never go on the seed
Clearing the last Moon trial earns Moonlit once, the result offers to wear it, and play draws it
The Keepsake Collection shows the store price, buys only through the store, and a refund falls back to Meadow without forgetting
The daily garden card shows today, this week and the bouquet, and its first clear pays seeds plus the bouquet on the fourth day
A daily garden cleared before this update pays only for new stars, and the seed reward names the next thing to grow
